name: Seoul Museum of Art
funding: Seoul Metropolitan Government museum. Hana Financial Group co-funds SeMA-Hana Art Award. Patrons' association SeMA人[in] since 2014.

name: Nam June Paik Art Center
funding: Hyundai Motor supports the Hyundai Translocal Series, announced in February 2025, in which the center exchanges with the Pinacoteca de São Paulo.

name: Fundació Antoni Tàpies
funding: Private foundation with Catalan public support.

name: Fundació Joan Miró
funding: Private foundation; Generalitat, Barcelona council and Culture Ministry sit on its board. Strategic allies: Fundación BBVA, Fundació la Caixa, Puig. Also Fundació Banc Sabadell, Abertis, Sorigué, Damm.

name: Hangar.org
funding: Generalitat de Catalunya Department of Culture, Ajuntament de Barcelona, European cultural research programs. Non-profit artist association.

name: La Virreina Centre de la Imatge
funding: Ajuntament de Barcelona (Barcelona City Council Institute of Culture - ICUB).

name: MACBA (Museu d'Art Contemporani de Barcelona)
funding: €13.2M budget. Consortium comprising the Generalitat de Catalunya, Ajuntament de Barcelona, Spanish Ministry of Culture, and Fundació MACBA.

name: Sónar Festival
funding: Owned by Superstruct Entertainment, which KKR acquired in 2024. Its site shows the Generalitat, Estrella Damm and drinks brands. Sónar says it sends KKR no money. No budget found.

name: Azkuna Zentroa (Alhóndiga Bilbao)
funding: Bilbao Ría 2000 contributed six million euros to the new building from the Abandoibarra action.

name: Bulegoa z/b
funding: Basque Government, Diputación Foral de Bizkaia, Bilbao City Council, the Creative Europe Programme of the EU and the Ministry of Culture and Sports support it.
